description: The one-time evaluation of the frozen release model on the test split (fold 10), following reports/TEST_PLAN.md. Nothing was chosen on these records: model, calibrators and thresholds were frozen on fold 9 before fold 10 was opened. Every number below was computed in this run.

git.note: the commit the code ran from; the commit adding this file and the tag are its children

probabilities: calibrated: per class sigmoid(a * logit + b) with the frozen calibrator of calibration.json
decision_rule: flag the class when its calibrated probability is >= the class's frozen threshold

bootstrap.method: percentile: the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles (numpy quantile, linear) of the values over resamples; each resample draws as many patients as the split has, with replacement, and keeps every record of each drawn patient
bootstrap.format: each estimated metric is {value: on all records, ci_low, ci_high}; support, prevalence, confusion counts, thresholds, reliability bins and the prior baseline are point values

max_f1.rule: per class, the threshold with the highest validation F1; among exact ties, the lowest threshold (same F1, higher sensitivity)

high_sensitivity.rule: per abnormal class, the highest threshold with validation sensitivity >= 0.90; NORM has none, as it is not an abnormality to be caught

calibration_error.definition: per class, sum over equal-width bins of (records in bin / records) x |observed frequency - mean predicted probability|; macro = mean over the five classes
calibration_error.interval_note: ECE is a binned, non-negative statistic and is biased upward under resampling, so its percentile interval (and that of the calibrated-minus-uncalibrated difference) describes spread, is not a confidence interval for the true ECE, and can lie above the point value.

baselines.fitted_on: the training split (folds 1-8), refitted in this run exactly as for reports/baselines_val.json

prior.description: every record scored with each class's training-split frequency; AUROC is 0.5 and AUPRC the prevalence by construction, so no interval is computed

feature_gbdt.description: 79 features per record (RR intervals from lead II beats, per-lead amplitude statistics), one sklearn 1.9.1 HistGradientBoostingClassifier per class with scikit-learn's default hyperparameters except early_stopping=False (a fixed max_iter; sklearn's early stopping would hold out records, not patients)

cnn_minus_feature_gbdt.description: paired: the same resampled patients score both models

seed_stability.description: Seed-to-seed spread of the committed config on the validation split (fold 9): each run's best checkpoint, uncalibrated sigmoid outputs (calibration is strictly increasing, so AUROC and AUPRC are the same either way). Training noise only, not an interval over patients. Each run's epoch was chosen on this split, so the values are slightly optimistic.

validation.description: The same scoring code on the validation split (fold 9) in this run: point values only. The calibration, the thresholds and the checkpoint epoch were chosen on fold 9, so these are optimistic; they reproduce reports/metrics_val.json and reports/calibration.json (checked).

checks.test_plan_and_code_committed: reports/TEST_PLAN.md committed; no modified tracked file and no untracked file under src, config, scripts, tests, reports/TEST_PLAN.md
checks.frozen_files: release.pt, calibration.json and thresholds.json have the SHA-256 values in reports/release.json
checks.release_reproduces_validation: release.pt reproduces the run's logged validation macro AUROC and AUPRC
checks.thresholds_rechosen_on_validation: re-choosing both operating points on fold 9 gives the frozen thresholds (largest difference 0.0e+00)
checks.seed_stability_reproduced: the three seed checkpoints reproduce every mean, std and per-run macro value of seed_stability_val.json (largest difference 0.0e+00)
checks.baselines_reproduce_validation: refitted on folds 1-8, both baselines reproduce reports/baselines_val.json on fold 9 (largest difference 0.0e+00)
checks.scoring_reproduces_validation_reports: this run's scoring code on fold 9 reproduces the ranking, operating-point and ECE values of metrics_val.json and calibration.json (largest difference 0.0e+00)
checks.order: all checks above passed before fold 10 was opened

figures_validation.description: not test-set figures: training curves of the release run and class support of the training and validation splits
